proposals.spec_says: The actor `on_idle()` remains active (returns `true`) while clients are connected or inflight operations exist.
proposals.code_does: Returns clients || inflight || pending_cancels; the bool is the framework's 'did work' park hint and never ends the loop.
proposals.old_text: - **NFR-006**: The actor `on_idle()` remains active (returns `true`) while clients are connected or inflight operations exist.
proposals.new_text: - **NFR-006**: The actor `on_idle()` returns `true` (the component-framework "did work" hint, which keeps the actor polling instead of parking) while clients are connected, inflight operations exist, or timed-out operations still have an `AsyncCancel` queued for submission (`pending_cancels`); otherwise it returns `false`. The return value is a park hint, not a liveness signal — returning `false` never terminates the actor loop (see FR-024). Consequently the actor busy-polls and does not park while any client is connected.

proposals.spec_says: Component MUST support graceful shutdown via `ControlMessage::Shutdown` which causes `on_idle()` to return `false`, terminating the actor loop.
proposals.code_does: Shutdown sets shutdown_requested; on_idle returns false without doing work; the loop ends when shutdown() calls ActorHandle::deactivate(), which closes the channel and joins the thread. In-flight ops get no completion.
proposals.old_text: - **FR-024**: Component MUST support graceful shutdown via `ControlMessage::Shutdown` which causes `on_idle()` to return `false`, terminating the actor loop.
proposals.new_text: - **FR-024**: Component MUST support graceful shutdown via `shutdown()` (also exposed as `IBlockDeviceAdmin::shutdown`), which sends `ControlMessage::Shutdown` to the actor and then deactivates it. On `Shutdown` the actor sets its shutdown flag, after which `on_idle()` returns `false` immediately and no longer polls clients, harvests completions or checks timeouts. The actor loop itself terminates when `ActorHandle::deactivate()` closes the control channel and joins the actor thread. Async operations still in flight at shutdown receive no completion.
proposals.confidence: HIGH (mechanism); MEDIUM (whether 'no completion' should be the contract)
proposals.approval_note: apply the mechanism text but DROP the last sentence ('Async operations still in flight at shutdown receive no completion.'); record 'what happens to in-flight async ops at shutdown' as an open item in align-tasks.md (see tasks.md T011)

proposals.requirement: Edge case: Async operation timeout (covers SC-005)
proposals.spec_says: **Async operation timeout**: Timed-out operations produce `Completion::Timeout` and an `AsyncCancel` is submitted to io_uring.
proposals.code_does: Timeout delivered at once; cancel key queued and pushed oldest-first; on a full SQ, submit()+one retry; anything left stays queued and is retried every tick; never dropped.
proposals.code_location: src/actor.rs:821-875 (Timeout :843, queue :844, retry :864-868, defer :869-871, empty-inflight drain :822-825)
proposals.old_text: - **Async operation timeout**: Timed-out operations produce `Completion::Timeout` and an `AsyncCancel` is submitted to io_uring.
proposals.new_text: - **Async operation timeout**: A timed-out operation is removed from the inflight map and `Completion::Timeout` is delivered immediately. An `AsyncCancel` for it is queued (`pending_cancels`, FIFO) and submitted to io_uring oldest-first; if the submission queue is full, the actor calls `submit()` to free slots and retries once, and a cancel that still does not fit stays queued and is retried on every subsequent idle-loop tick. The cancel is never dropped, but it may reach io_uring after `Completion::Timeout` was delivered, possibly several poll cycles later. The cancelled operation's own late CQE and the cancel's CQE (`user_data == 0`) are ignored.

proposals.spec_says: Owns the file descriptor (`OwnedFd`), `DeviceConfig`, `IoUring` ring, client sessions map, inflight operations map, and optional logger.
proposals.code_does: Also holds next_handle, pending_cancels (new), shutdown_requested, and feature-gated telemetry.
proposals.old_text: - **`KernelHandler`**: The actor handler implementing `ActorHandler<ControlMessage>`. Owns the file descriptor (`OwnedFd`), `DeviceConfig`, `IoUring` ring, client sessions map, inflight operations map, and optional logger.
proposals.new_text: - **`KernelHandler`**: The actor handler implementing `ActorHandler<ControlMessage>`. Owns the file descriptor (`OwnedFd`), `DeviceConfig`, `IoUring` ring, client sessions map, inflight operations map, the FIFO of timed-out operation keys whose `AsyncCancel` has not yet been submitted (`pending_cancels`, see the async-timeout edge case), the next-`OpHandle` counter, the shutdown flag, optional logger, and (with `--features telemetry`) the shared `TelemetryStats`.

proposals.spec_says: CQEs with `user_data & (1 << 63) != 0` are treated as internal fsync markers and silently ignored.
proposals.code_does: The filter exists, but no fsync or bit-63 SQE is ever produced by the component; only the new test's filler NOPs use the bit. Cancel SQEs use user_data 0.
proposals.old_text: - CQEs with `user_data & (1 << 63) != 0` are treated as internal fsync markers and silently ignored.
proposals.new_text: - CQEs with `user_data & (1 << 63) != 0` are silently ignored: bit 63 of `user_data` is reserved for internal SQEs that are not tracked operations. The component itself currently submits no such SQEs (there is no fsync — durability comes from `O_DSYNC`, FR-004); the unit test that fills the submission queue uses the bit for its filler NOPs. `AsyncCancel` SQEs use `user_data == 0`, which matches no `OpHandle` (handles start at 1), so their CQEs are ignored too.

proposals.spec_says: The `on_idle()` actor method returns `false` only when shutdown is requested; it returns `true` while clients or inflight ops exist to keep the actor thread alive.
proposals.code_does: Returns false after shutdown and whenever there are no clients/inflight/pending cancels; the value is a park hint; the thread ends only on deactivate().
proposals.old_text: - The `on_idle()` actor method returns `false` only when shutdown is requested; it returns `true` while clients or inflight ops exist to keep the actor thread alive.
proposals.new_text: - The `on_idle()` return value is the component-framework "did work" hint (see NFR-006), not a liveness signal: it is `false` once shutdown is requested and whenever there are no clients, no inflight ops and no queued cancels, and `true` otherwise. The actor thread ends only when `shutdown()` deactivates the actor (FR-024).

proposals.spec_says: Component MUST support `AbortOp` by submitting an `AsyncCancel` SQE to io_uring and sending an `AbortAck` completion.
proposals.code_does: handle_abort discards the SQ push result; on a full SQ no cancel is submitted, but the op is removed from inflight and AbortAck is sent anyway.
proposals.code_change: Route the abort cancel through pending_cancels + submit_pending_cancels() (src/actor.rs:856-875) instead of the direct push; decide whether to skip the cancel for handles no longer in inflight. Add a full-SQ unit test like src/repair_test_timeout_cancel.rs.
